title: AI Promotes a Four-Day Workweek? The Reality Is That AI Efficiency Has Instead Increased the Pressure on Employees to Work 9006 (9 AM to 6 PM, Monday to Friday)

content_html:
In recent years, leading tech giants such as Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta have invested billions of dollars annually to develop AI. Executives from these companies have repeatedly outlined an appealing vision: with artificial intelligence taking over routine tasks, humans will enjoy shorter working hours and be completely liberated from repetitive labor. Even a Google engineering director once predicted that the widespread adoption of AI would lead to a four-day workweek by 2025, while OpenAI has also advocated for companies to trial a four-day workweek without salary cuts.

However, recent revelations from former employees who left top AI companies indicate that the reality is the exact opposite of the initial optimistic expectations. AI has not reduced employees' working hours but instead significantly increased overall work intensity. During certain project peaks, some employees worked more than 90 hours per week, falling into an intense "9006" rhythm.

Industry insiders point out that the AI technology, which was supposed to relieve human burdens and improve health, has not translated its efficiency gains into more personal leisure time for workers. Instead, it has been transformed into additional pressure to achieve higher KPIs.

content_html_zh:
近年来，谷歌、OpenAI、Anthropic、Meta等领先科技巨头每年投入数十亿美元开发人工智能。 这些公司的高管多次勾勒出一个诱人的愿景：人工智能接管日常工作，人类将享受更短的工作时间，并从重复性劳动中彻底解放出来。 就连谷歌的一位工程总监也曾预测，到2025年，人工智能的广泛采用将导致每周工作四天，而OpenAI也主张企业在不减薪的情况下尝试每周工作四天。

然而，最近离开顶级人工智能公司的前员工透露的情况表明，现实与最初的乐观预期完全相反。 人工智能并没有减少员工的工作时间，反而显着提高了整体工作强度。 在某些项目高峰期，部分员工每周工作时间超过90小时，陷入紧张的“9006”节奏。

业内人士指出，人工智能技术本应减轻人类负担、改善健康，但并没有将其效率提升转化为工人更多的个人休闲时间。 相反，它已经转化为实现更高 KPI 的额外压力。
